jobs.title: Azure Databricks Developer
jobs.description:
📍 work from Poland
📍

Project Description:

We are seeking an experienced Azure Databricks Developer to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in Azure Databricks and Azure DevOps to design and implement scalable cloud-based data solutions. You will work closely with other data engineers, architects, and business teams to develop and optimize data pipelines, real-time data streaming, and cloud-based analytics solutions.
The applications primarily consist of data pipelines built in Azure Databricks. They either transform data and load it into downstream systems, or ingest data from upstream systems and transform it for further processing.
You will be part of the SaaS Data Layer implementation team responsible for building and maintaining the client environments of the new trading platform.
Luxoft will invest into your professional training and allow you to grow your professional career.

Responsibilities:

Cloud expertise in Azure Databricks, Azure DevOps, Azure Log Analytics. Knowledge of Azure network concepts, Azure Service Bus, Azure Functions is a plus.
Develop, implement, and maintain data pipelines and ETL processes using Azure Databricks.
Design and manage Azure Databricks for optimized data storage and retrieval.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define and implement data integration solutions across multiple sources and platforms.
Implement best practices for data governance, security, and compliance in cloud-based solutions.
Monitor and troubleshoot performance issues in Azure-based applications and data pipelines.
Automate deployment and monitoring processes using CI/CD pipelines.
Stay updated with emerging Azure technologies and provide recommendations for improvements.
Producing Architectural design diagram/Technical Documentation

Mandatory Skills Description:

10+ years experience in development
3+ years of hands-on experience with Azure cloud services, including Databricks and DevOps.
Strong proficiency Python and Pyspark or SQL for data transformation and analysis.
Experience with real-time data streaming and event-driven architectures.
Deep understanding of ETL/ELT workflows and big data processing frameworks.
Knowledge of Azure DevOps and CI/CD pipelines for automated deployments.
Familiarity with data security, governance, and compliance best practices in cloud environments.
Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to work in an agile development environment.
Strong communication and collaboration skills.

Nice-to-Have Skills Description:

Azure network concepts, Azure Service Bus, Azure Functions
Agile
Certifications such as Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Engineer Associate or Azure Solutions Architect.
Experience with Power BI or other visualization tools.
Knowledge of machine learning and AI-based analytics on Azure.

Languages:

English: C1 Advanced

jobs.title: .Net/C# developer to the Portfolio Solutions and Derivatives Clearing Tech team
jobs.description:
SEB is more than a bank. We are a technology-driven financial institution where everything starts from our customer needs and business outcomes. AI, data and modern engineering are natural parts of how we work, build and deliver value. From core banking platforms to agentic AI , automation, cybersecurity and cloud, we offer a broad tech landscape and many paths to grow. Together, we are shaping secure, responsible and future- proof solutions for our customers and society. Are you ready to take on a new challenge?

About the role:

As a Solution Developer, you will be part of a team responsible for developing and maintaining modern business solutions supporting two product areas: Portfolio Solutions and Derivatives Clearing. The domain is evolving, and you will contribute to building systems that create tangible customer and business value.

You will join a team of nine ambitious and creative colleagues, working primarily with back‑end solutions while also contributing to our future client‑facing portal, Business Arena. The role also includes participation in the development of several new cloud‑native solutions, in close collaboration with quantitative analysts within Investor Services and CIB, as well as our Solution Architect.

In this role, you will:

Work closely with product management and product specialists to explore ideas, refine requirements, and deliver business value
Develop and maintain business systems and integration
Contribute to the evolution of our microservice‑based architecture
Design and deliver innovative technical solutions across our product areas

To thrive in this role, we believe:

You are a solution‑oriented developer with a few years of experience in modern software development and a strong drive to deliver.
You enjoy working close to product management and business, turning ideas into solutions that create real value. You communicate well, thrive in collaborative teams, and are curious about financial markets.
You bring solid skills in C# and .NET / .NET Core, with hands‑on experience in Python, GCP, SQL Server, and REST APIs.
Experience with cloud-native architectures, containers, observability, or Angular is a plus. A positive mindset and eagerness to learn are essential.
Experience or interest in applying AI tools (e.g. generative AI, Copilot, or automation solutions) in software development.
Experience using LLMs as part of your development workflow, either professionally or through personal projects.

What we offer:

We offer many experiences and benefits to our employees, and there is nuance to every individual’s career experience, but the elements that define the core of our offering are:

Great opportunities for professional development and insight into Investor Services Institutions product landscape
A dynamic, professional, and multicultural environment
An empowering and inclusive workplace culture
Hybrid Workplace setup

Ready to take the next step on your career journey?

Since we select candidates continuously, feel free to send in your application today, but no later than 31st of August
. If you have questions about the position please contact Johan Schalling, Team manager by mail Johan.schalling@seb.se, but we will not process applications via email.

Please be aware that our final candidates undergo background checks, a process that includes for example identity control, verification of qualifications, credit checks, company engagements and history of crime. In some cases, we also apply random drug checks. During employment, employees within SEB can also expect to undergo recurring background checks. SEB Sweden has a redeployment responsibility, why this position might be covered by internal redeployment.

jobs.title: Systemutvecklare Fullstack
jobs.description:
Företagsbeskrivning

AFRY erbjuder tjänster inom teknik, design, digitalisering och rådgivning. Vi är dedikerade experter inom industri, energi och infrastruktur och skapar värde för kommande generationer. AFRY har nordiska rötter med global räckvidd. Våra gemensamma principer – Result driven, Client centric, Empowering och Accountable – vägleder oss i hur vi arbetar, utvecklas och lyckas tillsammans. Var med och accelerera övergången till ett hållbart samhälle.

Jobbeskrivning

Är du en helt vanlig eller ovanlig back-end-utvecklare, som vill ha roligt på jobbet, samarbeta med andra, bidra med din kompetens, ha en stöttande chef och vara del av ett riktigt härligt team i Enköping?
Bra, för precis det kan vi erbjuda dig!

I din roll som konsult kommer du att vara ansvarig för att utveckla och underhålla back-end-komponenter i olika projekt. Rollen innebär att arbeta både självständigt och i team, t.ex. genom att ensam eller tillsammans med kollegor ta ansvar för hela back-end-delen av ett projekt.

Vi driver både små och stora projekt från Enköping och har kunder inom flera olika branscher, t.ex. offentlig sektor och samhällsviktig verksamhet. Din vardag kommer se lite olika ut beroende på projekt, kund och uppdrag - och den variationen tror jag att du tycker känns kul!

Kvalifikationer

Dina tekniska färdigheter är förstås viktiga men vad du har att bidra med som person är lika viktigt det. I den här rollen behöver du t.ex. trivas med att samarbeta i team och dela ut och ta emot feedback, tycka att det är intressant när omständigheter förändras (t.ex. att du behöver lära dig en ny teknik eller nya arbetsuppgifter, byta kund, team eller projekt etc.), du motiveras av att hjälpa andra (t.ex. föreslå en teknisk förändring som är till hjälp för kunden) och du drar dig inte för att själv ta hjälp om du kör fast.

För att komma in med rätt tekniska förutsättningar tror vi att du:

Har minst 3 års erfarenhet av C#/.NET-utveckling
Har erfarenhet av att arbeta med REST API:er
Har erfarenhet av Azure och kunskap om DevOps och dess processer
Har erfarenhet av Microsoft SQL Server

Meriterande:

Erfarenhet av WPF
Erfarenhet av containerteknik (Podman, Kubernetes)
Erfarenhet av testdriven utveckling (TDD)
Erfarenhet av GIS

Utöver det är du svensk medborgare* och behärskar svenska i tal och skrift, då svenska krävs i kontakt med kollegor och kunder. Ett extra plus i kanten om du har tidigare erfarenhet av att arbeta som konsult!

För vissa uppdrag hos myndighet, region eller kommun krävs svenskt medborgarskap och godkänd säkerhetsprövning.

Ytterligare information

Välkommen med din ansökan, sista ansökningsdag är 2026-10-30

Kontaktperson för frågor:

Rebecka Gravås
, Gruppchef

rebecka.gravas@afry.com

Tel: 072 205 8117

Om rekryteringsprocessen:

I alla våra rekryteringsprocesser använder vi oss av kompetensbaserad rekrytering - för en rättvis och träffsäker rekrytering. Följande steg ingår i den här processen:

Telefonavstämning eller urvalsfrågor
1:a intervju (rekryterande chef)
Tekniskt test
2:a intervju (testuppföljning/teknisk intervju)
Referenstagning
Erbjudande

Läs gärna mer om hur vi arbetar med rekrytering på vår hemsida här: Rekryteringsprocessen på AFRY

Vad erbjuder vi dig?

En attraktiv arbetsmiljö med fokus på trivsel och utveckling. Du får utvecklas kontinuerligt genom uppdrag, utbildning och individuella kompetensplaner.
Konkurrenskraftiga villkor med förmåner som kollektivavtal, friskvård, företagsrabatter, pensionsplanering och generösa föräldraledighetsregler.
Ett stort nätverk av kompetenta kollegor i Sverige och internationellt.

Jag berättar gärna mer om våra förmåner under en intervju!

Vi undanber oss direktkontakt med bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag samt säljare av ytterligare jobbannonser.

På AFRY driver vi förändring i allt vi gör. Vi anser att förändring sker när modiga idéer möts, när vi samarbetar, skapar innovation och omfamnar kreativa lösningar, det är så vi skapar framtiden. jobs.title: Solution Engineer - Integration Delivery
jobs.description:
This is an opportunity to combine hands-on software engineering with end-to-end ownership to build APIs and integrations that support business-critical operations while contributing to a reusable integration platform. Welcome to Sandvik Group IT!

Some of the things you'll do here:

Build and own integrations from initial design through deployment and production support.
Work with modern engineering practices covering APIs, automation, Infrastructure as Code and CI/CD.
Turn delivery experience into reusable components, templates and technical improvements.

Your mission

In this role, you design, develop and maintain custom integrations and APIs for business areas and projects built natively on Azure Integration Services. Your work combines hands-on engineering with production responsibility, and you ensure that each delivery follows standardized patterns for security, logging, monitoring, resilience and error handling. You’re part of the PA Engineering Platforms Integration team and report to the Competence Manager.

Job responsibilities:

Design and develop production-ready APIs and integrations using synchronous, asynchronous and event-driven patterns with Azure Logic Apps, Azure Functions, Azure Service Bus, Event Grid and Azure API Management.
Build integration logic, APIs and automation components in C# or Python, supported by Bash or PowerShell scripting.
Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines and Infrastructure as Code for repeatable, automated deployments.
Implement technical guardrails for authentication, authorization, secrets, certificates, networking, logging, monitoring and policy validation.
Own live integrations in production, including troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, incident resolution and performance improvements.
Convert delivery learnings into reusable templates, platform components, runbooks, post-mortems and clear technical documentation.

Location

This position is based at the World Trade Center in Stockholm or Mossvägen in Sandviken.

Your profile

You’re an experienced integration engineer with a strong background in building and operating enterprise integrations. Combining software engineering with integration expertise, you understand how APIs, cloud services, automation and operations come together to create secure, reliable and maintainable solutions.

Your background also includes:

Hands-on experience with Azure Integration Services, including Logic Apps, Azure Functions, Service Bus, Event Grid and Azure API Management. You’ve designed resilient integrations with effective retry, error-handling and monitoring approaches and understand the engineering practices required to operate integrations in production.
Strong programming skills in C# or Python, alongside experience using Bash or PowerShell for deployment and operational automation.
Practical knowledge of REST APIs, messaging, asynchronous communication, and event-driven integration patterns.
Experience with CI/CD, automated deployments and Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, Bicep or similar technologies.
Knowledge of cloud platforms, containerization, observability, resilience, security controls, and production support.

Methodical and pragmatic in your approach, you stay composed when solving incidents and complex technical challenges. You take ownership, listen closely to business needs, and make sound decisions that balance delivery speed with long-term maintainability. Collaboration comes naturally, and you enjoy sharing knowledge with architects, platform engineers, product stakeholders, and other delivery teams.

Our culture

At Sandvik, we’re tech driven, innovative, and entrepreneurial. We believe that success is a team effort, so we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive culture where people can be themselves and reach their full potential. So, we invest in supporting each other, learning together, and celebrating our differences. Visit our stories hub, LinkedIn or Facebook to get to know us further.

Contact information

For further information about this position, please contact Mikael Berglund, hiring manager, mikael.b.berglund@sandvik.com
